# Commit message deny-list for Orange Rails (DL-0855)
# ERE patterns, one per line. Lines beginning with # are comments.
# IMPORTANT: this file is published to a PUBLIC repo.
# Use SHAPE patterns only -- no literal internal hostnames, project IDs,
# or domain names. Literal identifiers belong in the COMMIT_MSG_DENY_PATTERNS
# repo secret (base64-encoded, one ERE pattern per line). The workflow loads
# and appends them at runtime without committing them here.
# Set that secret via: repo Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions.
# Workflow: .github/workflows/commit-msg-scan.yml

# ---------- Tailnet IPs and MagicDNS ----------
# Matches any 100.x.x.x address (Tailscale CGNAT range)
100\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+
# Tailscale MagicDNS domain suffix
\.ts\.net

# ---------- Internal service domain shapes ----------
# Matches waggle.<org>.<tld> (internal chat/relay servers)
waggle\.[a-z][a-z0-9-]+\.(com|dev)
# Matches wiki.<org>.dev (internal wiki servers)
wiki\.[a-z][a-z0-9-]+\.dev

# ---------- Ride session seat names ----------
# sp-1 through sp-10 are internal ride seats and must not appear publicly
\bsp-([1-9]|10)\b

# ---------- Zulip message-ID citations ----------
# Matches patterns like "msg 2467" or "msg_id: 12345"
\bmsg\s+[0-9]{4,}\b
\bmessage[_-]id\s*[:=]\s*[0-9]+\b
